rows.section: Personal income tax
rows.label: Income tax on individuals (salary, wages)
rows.note: The UAE levies no income tax on individuals. Self-employed income counts toward the AED 1 million business-turnover test; salary never does.
rows.source_title: u.ae: Taxation; Cabinet Decision No. 49 of 2023 (natural persons and Corporate Tax)

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and remote workers
rows.label: MoHRE freelance work permit
rows.value: For individuals working independently without an employer sponsor or employment contract, including foreign nationals on self-sponsored residence visas
rows.note: No personal income tax applies to freelance or remote-work income; business turnover above AED 1 million brings Corporate Tax registration.
rows.source_title: u.ae: Work permits (updated 19 October 2026)

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and remote workers
rows.label: Free-zone freelance permits
